purpose: Generic-path check of the RSI core on an operating-condition study of the Lu 2016 pilot DMTO reactor: feed mass-flow scale x bed temperature, current 211-hole distributor, coarse mesh. Objective: maximize gas-phase C2H4+C3H6 selectivity at z=1.0 m while keeping MeOH conversion >= 99 %. Model-based answer for this mesh and kinetics, not a plant recommendation.

bounds.T_note: kinetics arr2 = two-point Arrhenius (k) and linear (alpha) fit of Lu 2016 Table 3 between 723 and 748 K; outside this range it is extrapolation

control_reference.source: rsi/distributor contract targets.kpi_paper_cfd (base condition, current 211-hole design)
